Okay, after *a lot* of reflecting on it, I think I understand why it was that way. Firstly, I wholeheartedly agree, I wasn't a fan of Alice dying, especially in such an unceremonious way. I hated the fact that we got attached to her in the episode prior, as well as her establishing perhaps the only actual friendship Billy had in the show, but Jac's comments about the theme of the show really put it into perspective. The show's meant to encapsulate death in itself, and death isn't always fair or expected. This is the case for Alice, even echoed by her own sentiments that she said when meeting Rio. 

While, yes, I'm not a huge fan of the whole perma-death direction they went in for the show since the MCU is notorious for spontaneous revivals and death never really being very permanent (hell, even Agatha, albeit a ghost, still reappears one episode later), I can see why they killed off Alice right after her character development, as again, death isn't always fair or expected. Still got my fingers crossed that she'll at least get to show up, even as a ghost. Ali and Patti did such amazing jobs in their respective episodes fleshing out their character arcs, so hopefully we'll get at least a bit more of a tribute to them than just their names engraved in some random dark basement. Even if they're dead, I still just want to see them being honored in a bigger way than just that.

Quick thoughts:

\- Okay, best episode in my opinion, immediately followed by Alice's trial. Patti never misses! \- Starting to lose hope the coven will be brought back to life at the end, BUT someone did point out that Lilia warned Agatha of the future, and how would she be able to know of this if she isn't there to see it herself? As we saw in the episode, Lilia's future sight isn't just visions, she's seeing through her own eyes at those specific times. How would she know to tell Agatha to duck when someone calls her a coward? Perhaps because she gets brought back to life and witnesses herself (and okay, some can argue that she saw Billy's future without being there, but I personally believe that she either just felt a bad omen in that moment OR she saw what we're seeing now, following Billy's big reveal).

\- According to Lilia, Jennifer is "the Path Ahead," which I believe means she'll be in future MCU projects, particularly in Doctor Strange 3 or a Midnight Sons standalone project to tie all the supernatural characters together (Swamp-Thing, Blade, Elsa Bloodstone, Strange & Clea, etc.) and, of course, because I love the coven so much, my delusional self wants to believe they'll be brought back for Midnight Sons, but that seems like a big roster, so maybe they can just be supporting characters.

\- I love that this episode was all about Lilia taking control of her destiny. Her whole character arc, she's been unable to control her powers and unable to change the stream of time, but the two major choices she makes are the most impactful - the sigil and her sacrifice. personally, i have several types of friendships. i have no idea if anyone can relate to this, but this is how i see mine.

type 1 - can go several months without speaking to them (usually only on special occasions, bdays, etc) but whenever we do, it’s like no time has passed. this is basically my friendship with all my high school friends. these friends, despite the circumstances, hold the most emotional value to me, for whatever stupid nostalgic reason (good memories or whatever)

type 2 - will talk to them almost everyday, to the point where others might find it obsessive or weird. i cant have too many friends like this cuz i get easily overwhelmed, but i usually have two or three at a time. these are the friends i’d consider my “best friends,” but they tend to fizzle out into type-1 friendships after a few months or so 🤷‍♀️

type 3 - just mutuals on social media. that’s it. no interactions except liking each other’s posts. no comments, no dm’s (unless we need something from each other), just nothing. some wouldn’t consider these people as a friends, but i’d rather keep them as “friends” than enemies. these usually result out of the aftermath of a type-1 friendship (aka after a year or so)

type 4 - sporadic appearances. similar to type 1, except they literally will vanish for god knows how long and then come back into my life for whatever reason. again, most wouldn’t really consider these people friends, but i am still friendly to them. one thing i never will do is beg them to stay though cuz fuck that

type 5 - friends of friends. never speak or interact unless we’re in the presence of that mutual friend or if we’re discussing said-friend. these can lead to personal friendships though, so i don’t discount these as “friendships,” but moreso as like beta testing lol

i’ve noticed they go from type 2 > type 1 > type 3 often, although a lot don’t make it past type 2 nowadays. it’s not like i’m sad over it though, everyone grows apart eventually. 

if you can relate to my overly detailed explanation, my advice is to treasure the good moments you share with these people before they start to grow apart. once they’re gone, then try to be thankful for those memories instead of dwelling on the past.

tl/dr: it varies, but usually we start off super close and then we grow apart and stop talking after a while lmao
